symptom: The shadow evidence Draft 2020-12 schema lacked maximum bounds on 13 fixed integer counters and dynamic reason/taxonomy counts. A schema-only consumer could accept JSON integers above 2^53-1 that the runtime rejects with Number.isSafeInteger; a downstream consumer could overstate exact counter precision. This was a synthetic schema/runtime contract mismatch, not observed private evidence corruption or production impact.
lesson: JSON Schema integer type does not impose JavaScript safe-integer precision. A schema-only consumer and runtime validator disagree unless every numeric count is explicitly bounded at 9007199254740991, including additionalProperties dictionaries.
guardrail: Keep maximum:9007199254740991 on every fixed nonnegative integer count and on dynamic reason/taxonomy count-map values; retain the existing tighter scope.limit maximum and runtime safe-integer checks. Add schema metadata parity regressions for all 14 counter rules. Schema acceptance alone never authenticates K evidence, finality, evaluation readiness or production authority.
